name: Barter's Reach

stars.name: Barter
stars.notes: Older G-type star with stable output, slightly cooler than Sol. Long stellar lifespan has allowed complex ecosystems to develop.

planets.name: Haggle
planets.notes: Tidally locked cinder world, used as a relay point for system-wide communications arrays.

planets.name: Handshake
planets.notes: Temperate trade world with population of 1.4 billion. Famous for its open-air markets built into canyon networks that stretch for hundreds of kilometers.

planets.name: Escrow
planets.notes: Dry, wind-scoured world with deep subsurface vaults used as secure cargo storage by the system's banking houses.

planets.name: Collateral
planets.notes: Amber-banded gas giant with extensive moon system. Three moons host fuel processing facilities.

planets.name: Interest
planets.notes: Smaller ice giant with a faint ring system. Orbital research stations study its unusual atmospheric chemistry.

planets.name: Lien
planets.notes: Frozen outer world. Automated ice harvesting operations supply water to the inner system.

asteroid_belts.name: The Broker's Field
asteroid_belts.notes: Low-density belt with scattered mining claims. Known for occasional finds of rare crystalline formations prized by collectors.

stations.name: Canyon Market Station
stations.notes: Primary orbital trade hub, specializing in agricultural goods and artisanal exports from Handshake's canyon communities.

stations.name: Escrow Vault
stations.notes: Heavily fortified storage facility and banking center. Neutral ground for high-value transactions between rival factions.

faction_control.notes: Loose confederation of independent traders and local governance councils. Prides itself on handshake agreements and reputation-based commerce.

history: Colonized in 2356 by settlers seeking distance from the centralized trade regulations of the core systems, Barter's Reach was built on the principle that commerce should be personal and trust-based.

The canyon markets of Handshake grew organically over centuries, becoming famous across the sector for their unique blend of face-to-face trading and artisanal goods that cannot be found in mass-produced catalogs.

The Escrow Vault on the third planet was established in 2491 after the Pictor Banking Crisis, providing a neutral and physically secure location for high-value transactions that neither side trusted to electronic systems alone.
description: Barter's Reach is a system built on the old ways of commerce, where deals are sealed with a handshake and reputation matters more than regulation. The aging yellow-orange star Barter casts warm light over six worlds, of which Handshake alone thrums with life. Its famous canyon markets, carved into the walls of vast rift valleys by wind and commerce alike, draw buyers and sellers who prefer the tactile reality of examining goods in person over the cold efficiency of automated trading platforms.

The system sees moderate traffic, primarily from independent traders, artisan collectives, and buyers seeking specialty goods unavailable through conventional supply chains. Canyon Market Station handles the bulk of orbital commerce, while the Escrow Vault on the third planet serves as the sector's most trusted neutral ground for high-stakes transactions. The Pictor Freehold Alliance governs with a light hand, maintaining just enough infrastructure to keep trade flowing while preserving the personal character that defines Barter's Reach.

The system's deliberate embrace of tradition conceals a quiet vulnerability. As automated trading networks expand and younger generations prefer digital efficiency, Barter's Reach faces an existential question about whether its handshake economy can survive. More immediately concerning are the subsurface vaults of Escrow, whose contents are known only to their depositors. Intelligence agencies across three factions suspect that the vaults hold items far more dangerous than mere cargo, but the Freehold Alliance refuses all inspection demands, arguing that trust, once broken, cannot be rebuilt.
